concept.title: Scenario: enterprise documentation scale
concept.shortdesc: A telecommunications company maintains documentation for 47 products across 12 languages. Using DITA:

conbody.p: A telecommunications company maintains documentation for 47 products across 12 languages. Using DITA:

ul.li: 3,200 individual topic files contain the core content
89 DITA maps organize these topics into different deliverables
A single terminology update propagates to all 47 products automatically
